user.title: Set up Huawei Modbus Bridge
user.description: After setup, reconfigure Huawei Solar to use 127.0.0.1 and the local port below. Keep the existing Modbus unit IDs.

data_description.mac: Enter the MAC address of the network device Huawei Solar connects to, such as the Smart Dongle, EMMA, or inverter.
data_description.unit_id: Use the first unit ID from the existing Huawei Solar installation. This is used to read and verify its serial number.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid MAC address, such as 94:25:33:12:34:56.
error.port_in_use: Another Huawei Modbus Bridge already uses this local port.

abort.already_configured: This MAC address is already configured.
